name: ai-builder-kit
description: Jack's skills for AI coding agents: diagrams, decks, demo videos, git ledger commits, conversation logging and AEM admin workflows. Every skill is installable on its own or all at once.

plugins.name: ai-knowledge-harvester
plugins.description: Harvest AI docs, prompt logs and agent configs from repos or pasted AI exports into a private knowledge repo with a project-first taxonomy.

plugins.name: branded-pptx
plugins.description: Create on-brand PowerPoint decks from a template .pptx: analyzes themes, masters and layouts, then generates slides that match. Requires the anthropic pptx skill and Python 3.12+.

plugins.name: chat-conversation-logger
plugins.description: Log claude.ai chat conversations as dated markdown files with verbatim prompts, attachment metadata and per-turn tool records.

plugins.name: competing-pr-triage
plugins.description: Compare two PRs or branches produced by different agents for the same goal and recommend which to adopt, with a requirements table and scope audit.

plugins.name: conversation-logger
plugins.description: Log Claude Code and Codex sessions as per-session dated markdown files with a stage counter so folders sort chronologically.

plugins.name: drawio
plugins.description: Generate .drawio XML diagrams in Jack's brand style with a render-view-fix loop and versioned iterations. Requires the draw.io CLI for PNG export.

plugins.name: excalidraw
plugins.description: Generate .excalidraw diagrams in Jack's brand style with a mandatory render-view-fix loop. Requires uv and Playwright Chromium for rendering.

plugins.name: hlx-admin-api-executor
plugins.description: Interactive AEM Edge Delivery Services Admin API executor: plan, run one request at a time with human review, and document every call. Soft guardrails only; the guarded plugin adds enforced ones.

plugins.name: jack-git-commit
plugins.description: Conventional Commits with traceable metadata footers (Goal, Step, Worker, Skill, Tools) so git log works as a queryable work ledger. Never pushes.

plugins.name: playwright-demo-video
plugins.description: Generate polished demo MP4s from Playwright specs with captions, ElevenLabs voiceover and background music. Requires ffmpeg, Node 18+ and Playwright in the target project.

plugins.name: podcast-slides-video
plugins.description: Build a YouTube-ready MP4 from narrated audio plus a slide deck, cutting slide changes to the transcript. Requires ffmpeg, uv, poppler and LibreOffice for PPTX input.

plugins.name: ai-builder-kit
plugins.description: Every skill in this marketplace as one plugin. Install this or the individual skill plugins, not both.

plugins.name: hlx-admin-api-executor-guarded
plugins.description: AEM Edge Delivery Services Admin API executor with a PreToolUse hook that blocks destructive curl commands to admin.hlx.page until the user approves.
